_comment: In-level boosters. `power` + `targeted:true` means the player arms it and taps a board cell to detonate that power there; `instant:true` boosters fire immediately. Cost/value are data-driven for live balancing — prices scale with the booster's board impact (bomb < lightning < freeze < rainbow) so the in-level shop rewards strategic use without trivialising the difficulty curve. Client purchases with soft currency only; premium-currency grants must go through a trusted service boundary (see docs/SECURITY.md).

boosters.label: Lightning
boosters.help: Clears a full row and column.

boosters.label: Freeze
boosters.help: Shatters a diamond and frosts the ring.

boosters.label: Rainbow
boosters.help: Clears every jewel of one colour.
